contract.purpose: Kith helps iPhone users who care about a small set of relationships retain meaningful context through explicitly chosen closeness, standing notes and a dated memory log.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Kith helps a person remember the people they genuinely want to stay close to and act with more thoughtfulness.
contract.driftNote: Canonical Kith purpose agrees with relationship memory. Its owner-validation nextAction and broader attention outcome differ from the current public internal-beta status and explicitly chosen closeness. This local marketing receipt follows repository evidence; the user prohibits production-config edits, so the canonical provider config is untouched.
contract.audience: iPhone users tending a small set of relationships; per-product audience preserved throughout the factory.
contract.job: Understand one native app, inspect authentic evidence and take its honest available next action.
contract.thesis: A living memory book: human moments and physical keepsakes frame exact native app evidence and a clear available action.
contract.system: Ivory paper, coral cloth, indigo semantic ink and rust actions; confident rounded sans; asymmetric desktop spread, action-first phone stack, alternating screenshot chapters. Product tokens and device classes remain independent.
contract.signature: Product-owned bookcloth stage, overlapping illustrative photograph and semantic paper sheet with handwritten margin note.
contract.risk: Art can overpower product comprehension or loading; retain visible action and evidence, optimized art and reduced-motion fallback.
